lessons.description: Checkpoint: implement createServerConfig(port = 8080) using a default parameter (default function parameters initialize named parameters when no value is passed) and return the shorthand object { port, env: 'development' }. Tests check createServerConfig(3000).port === 3000, createServerConfig().port === 8080, and env === 'development'.

lessons.title: Practice ES Modules import export
lessons.description: Modules provide top-level scoping — nothing is global unless explicitly exported. Replace the placeholders: export a const appName with the value 'Patchwork' and export a function formatTitle(title) that returns a template literal: ${title} - ${appName} (note the hyphen and spaces). The test imports your module as an ES module.
learning_objectives: This step prints the label that an export would share, using labelValue holding umber.

source.name: MDN Web Docs — Guide — JavaScript modules: 'Modules provide top-level scoping'

tests.name: test_es_module_exports
tests.unittest_code:
if (solution.appName !== 'Patchwork') throw new Error('appName mismatch');
if (solution.formatTitle('Learn') !== 'Learn - Patchwork') throw new Error('formatTitle mismatch');
